curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach arrow boards, flagger flags and paddles, zipper merging and work zone speed.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per work zone rule; contrast card for flags versus paddles.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what a described flagger or board requires.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover required stops, crossbucks and active warnings, crossing safely, escaping a stuck vehicle and the special crossing situations.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each crossing rule; contrast cards for a crossbuck alone versus with a stop sign and for a train coming versus none.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what a driver must do at a described crossing.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain size limits, truck stopping distance, blind spots, passing, turning and cutting in.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for stopping, blind spots and passing; contrast card for car versus truck stopping.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on safe driving around a tractor-trailer.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the move-over or slow-down rule and its infraction classes, then school bus lights, stopping rules and penalties.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for Class A versus Class B and amber versus red bus lights.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what a driver must do near a described vehicle.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover sharing lanes with motorcycles, passing and turning near bicyclists, bike lanes and markings, horses, officers and processions.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each sharing rule; contrast card for following motorcycles versus passing bicyclists.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on right of way with described road users.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach parking on hills, reversing, parallel parking, banned parking places and yielding to pedestrians.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each parking and pedestrian rule; contrast card for downhill versus uphill wheels.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on whether a described parking spot or turn is allowed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the seat belt law and fit, child restraints and back-seat advice, then warning devices for disabled cars, trucks and long loads.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each belt, child and warning rule; contrast cards for car versus truck devices and day versus night.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on belts, child seating and marking a disabled vehicle.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec08-m01..sec08-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

domain_emphasis_check.domain: Safe vehicle operation: work zones, railroad crossings, sharing the road, the Move Over law, school buses, parking and reversing, pedestrians, seat belts and child restraints, and disabled-vehicle warnings
Safe operation part two confusables and continuation

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
